profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Software Engineer experienced in developing full stack JavaScript applications using NodeJs Express React Redux GraphQL MongoDB MySQL

Contributor to Caseblink Tech Talk Series - AWS/CoudTech
Co-creator of Kafka Kare, a Apache Kafka cluster error handling and visualizer tool

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Kafka Kare simplifies the monitoring of Apache Kafka ecosystems by providing an intuitive interface to visualize topics, partitions, and consumer groups. It includes built-in alerting features that enable users to detect issues like lagging consumers or high throughput promptly, ensuring the stability and efficiency of Kafka setups.

As an open-source web app, Kafka Kare offers robust visualization and real-time alerting for Kafka environments. It seamlessly integrates with Kafka clusters, allowing users to monitor data streams, track essential metrics, and receive Slack alerts for critical events.
